judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: A função concatenava o texto de `busca` no literal SQL usado por `LIKE` e executava a consulta resultante. Caracteres da entrada podiam ser interpretados como sintaxe SQL.
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:78-85 (planted :82), category seguranca, states the concatenation into the LIKE literal. Fixed with a mysqli prepared statement binding '%'.$busca.'%' (delivered lib.php:115, 125-129); probe corrigida=true. %/_ are deliberately left as wildcards (the matrix note would call that partial), but C3 follows the probe (rulings A7, F2).

planted.report_excerpt: A página inseria `busca` no atributo `value` e no texto de um parágrafo sem codificar caracteres especiais. O navegador podia interpretar texto recebido na URL como marcação ou código
planted.rationale: F6 at index.php:76-83 names both output points (:79 attribute, :82 paragraph). htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') computed once and used in both places (delivered index.php:107, 112, 115).

planted.report_excerpt: Títulos e nomes de técnicos eram colocados no CSV diretamente. A delimitação com `fputcsv` preserva a célula, mas não define seu tipo ao abrir uma planilha. Leitores que inferem fórmulas podem avaliar conteúdo textual
planted.rationale: F11 at lib.php:136-144 (planted :140) describes CSV formula injection and the apostrophe prefix for cells starting with formula characters. textoParaCsv() prefixes ' (delivered lib.php:196, 209-218); probe corrigida=true. The sanitizer is also applied to the Tecnico column and turns the '-' placeholder into "'-" (ticket 104 in the seed): charged as PEN-001 per rulings C / rule 10, not as COMP, so C5 stays full.

planted.report_excerpt: `session_start()` abria a sessão e o login gravava a identidade nela sem trocar seu identificador. ... Se um terceiro conseguisse fixar um identificador válido antes da autenticação, ele poderia reaproveitar a sessão autenticada.
planted.rationale: F9 at index.php:15-27 (planted :24, within 10 lines) is session fixation with the right mechanism. session_regenerate_id(true) before writing uid/papel (delivered index.php:52), plus strict mode and cookie flags.

planted.report_excerpt: O login calculava um MD5 direto da senha e o comparava à coluna `CHAR(32)` ... Senhas idênticas geravam hashes idênticos. Uma cópia da tabela permite verificar palpites rapidamente
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:13-20 (planted :15). password_hash/password_verify with transparent migration: a legacy md5 hash is checked with hash_equals and re-hashed on a valid login with a compare-and-swap UPDATE (delivered lib.php:15-51). schema.sql widens senha to VARCHAR(255) and seed.sql re-hashes the same test passwords with bcrypt: not COMP-009 (rulings B, rule 8). The re-hash into an unwidened CHAR(32) is a deployment caveat covered by the delivered schema and the report's ALTER TABLE, not PEN-001.

planted.report_excerpt: `DB_PASS` possuía um valor de fallback no código e `SMTP_API_KEY` era um literal usado diretamente na configuração. Quem recebe uma cópia do pacote obtém os valores.
planted.rationale: F5 at config.php:7-15 covers both literals (:12, :15) and leaves rotation to deployment. Both literals are gone: DB_PASS is getenv-only (null when unset, and index.php:19-21 fails with a generic 500), SMTP_API_KEY is getenv ?: null (delivered config.php:11-16). C3 full under rule 11; a mandatory DB_PASS is a deployment requirement (BA), not PEN-001.

planted.report_excerpt: A rota repassava apenas o ID a `verChamado`, que filtrava por `id` em `lib.php` (linhas 98–101). O proprietário do chamado nunca era comparado com o usuário autenticado. Um cliente podia ler o título, a descrição, o status e a prioridade de outro cliente.
planted.rationale: F2 at index.php:52-64 (planted :53) is the IDOR. The detail route calls verChamadoVisivel($db, id, $donoId), adding AND usuario_id = uid for clients only; technicians ($donoId null) still see every ticket, and verChamado(mysqli,int) is kept as a wrapper (delivered index.php:69, 84; lib.php:135-149). Filtering in the query is an accepted alternative (KEY note, rulings A8). C5 none: the same visibility work scopes the panel's SLA average to the logged-in client (index.php:106, mediaRespostaVisivel), which is COMP-003 charged to SEC-017's C5 as in every earlier verdict (rulings B, rule 13).

planted.report_excerpt: O contador só crescia para linhas com `minutos_resposta` preenchido. Com a tabela vazia ou todos os valores nulos, o código dividia por zero. O painel podia interromper a listagem no PHP 8 antes de devolver HTML.
planted.rationale: F13 at lib.php:107-116 (planted :116), category bug. Returns 0.0 when COUNT is 0 (delivered lib.php:168); probe corrigida=true. F20 at the same lines describes a different (performance) issue and is an extra.

No finding says that $fp stays open on the `$res === false` early return. F8 at lib.php:123-150 is at the right lines but describes the shared on-disk export file (truncation/mixing between concurrent requests), another defect, so it is not a report of this flaw (rulings A4, the BO/CG precedent). Silent fix: the query now runs before fopen('php://output') and fclose runs in a finally block (delivered lib.php:183-205), so the handle is closed on every path.

planted.report_excerpt: A listagem chamava `tecnicoNome` para cada linha e a exportação repetia o padrão em `lib.php` (linhas 136–137). Cada ID não nulo acionava outro SELECT
planted.rationale: F16 at lib.php:87-91 (planted :89 and :137, credited once). One LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') AS tecnico_nome in the shared query for listing and export (delivered lib.php:105-130); probe corrigida=true. tecnicoNome() was removed; it is not in the manifest's public surface, so no COMP-004.

planted.report_excerpt: Login, exportação, detalhe e lista eram blocos sequenciais no mesmo arquivo, com HTML emitido diretamente. Status e prioridade eram formatados em dois fluxos de saída. Alterações transversais precisam considerar vários pontos de saída
planted.rationale: F24 at index.php:17-97 (planted :41-97), category arquitetura, names the dispatcher mixing routing, authentication and HTML and why it hurts (cross-cutting changes must touch several output points, formatting duplicated across two output flows): R1 and R2 full. Deliberately not refactored ('Mantive a estrutura procedural'): index.php still routes, authorizes and builds HTML inline, so R3 none and R4 none.

Magic numbers are not reported anywhere. F22 at lib.php:26-34 is at formatarStatus but describes the 'Resolvido' fallback for out-of-domain values (contracted behaviour, kept), not the bare 1/2/3 and 3/4/30 literals, so it is an extra (rulings A4, A10). The literals remain in the delivered code (lib.php:58-63, 72-81).

planted.report_excerpt: O cálculo colocava a ausência de resposta, o nível de prioridade, o limite de 30 minutos e a exceção de criticidade em níveis sucessivos de `if` e `else`. Uma alteração nos limiares ou rótulos fica sujeita a mudar acidentalmente um dos ramos de SLA.
planted.rationale: F23 at lib.php:40-58 (planted :43), category qualidade. Rewritten with guard clauses (delivered lib.php:70-82); the truth table is unchanged (null -> Aguardando; prioridade < 3 -> Normal; minutos <= 30 -> dentro do SLA; prioridade 4 -> CRITICO, otherwise atrasado), so R4 full.

extra_findings: F3 - listing and search showed other clients' tickets (index.php:72-94): legitimate enforcement of the manifest's visibility rule; the web listing filters by usuario_id for clients only

F4 - web CSV exported every ticket to clients (index.php:41-47): the web CSV is filtered to the client's own tickets while technicians and the global exportarCsv() keep every ticket; enforcement, not COMP-003 (rulings B)
F8 - shared on-disk export file truncated and re-read by concurrent requests (lib.php:123-150): real race and residual data file; fixed by streaming to php://output
F10 - role and account existence never re-validated after login (index.php:20-39): hardening; the role is now read from usuarios on every request
F12 - panel SLA average included tickets outside the client's scope (index.php:72-78): the fix scopes the average for clients, charged as COMP-003
F14 - mysqli constructor throws before the connect_errno check and errors could reach the browser (index.php:9-13): generic 500 handler, display_errors off
F15 - no login rate limiting (index.php:20-29): real, left open
F17 - array-shaped request parameters reach scalar functions (index.php:20-23, 53, 73): real, validated at the boundary
F18 - fputcsv relied on the default backslash escape, deprecated in PHP 8.4 (lib.php:138-144): real, escape '' passed explicitly
F19 - listing unbounded and leading-% LIKE scans the visible set (lib.php:78-92): real scalability note, left open; proposes no index, so not the PERF-006 decoy
F20 - mediaResposta pulled every row into PHP (lib.php:107-116): real, aggregated with SUM/COUNT
F21 - fputcsv quoted the 'Aberto em' header so its bytes differ from the manifest's literal (lib.php:125-130): real, literal header written (allowed, rule 9)
F22 - status values outside 1-3 labelled 'Resolvido' (lib.php:26-34): contracted behaviour called a bug, behaviour kept, so an extra (rule 14)

comp_violations.detail: index.php:106 calls mediaRespostaVisivel($db, $donoId), so a client's panel shows the SLA average over that client's tickets only instead of the contracted global figure (finding F12). Same ruling as B, C, G, H, I and the later SLA-scoping deliveries; charged to SEC-017's C5 (rule 13). The public mediaResposta() stays global.

notes: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5); the zeros above are placeholders. Binding: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A, versao 1.1, matrix 68088abd...c8625, matching mecanico.json and the package. RELATORIO.md and achados.json agree: the same 24 findings, locations, categories, confidences and corrigido flags (20 fixed, 4 open, as the summary says). Mechanical: 22/22 characterization green, the four probes fixed. Mapping: 11 findings matched planted rows (F1 SEC-001, F6 SEC-003, F11 SEC-008, F9 SEC-013, F7 SEC-014, F5 SEC-015, F2 SEC-017, F13 BUG-001, F16 PERF-001, F24 ARCH-002, F23 CLN-007), 13 are extras, no false positives, no decoy (no exec claim; F19 proposes no index). PEN-001 x1: textoParaCsv() is applied to the Tecnico column, so the '-' placeholder of an unassigned ticket (seed ticket 104) is exported as "'-", the precedent of G, V, AU and AV; this also makes F11's 'altera apenas esses valores' claim inexact (an EXPL matter). COMP: one COMP-003 for the client-scoped SLA average, on SEC-017's C5; the client-filtered web CSV and listing with technicians and the global functions keeping every ticket is enforcement. Hesitations: BUG-004 (F8 sits at the right lines but describes the shared-file race, never the handle left open on the early return, so it is a silent fix per A4); ARCH-009 (F22 sits at formatarStatus but describes the fallback, not the literals); ARCH-002 R2 (explanation is short but states the real coupling and its consequence, given full); SEC-001 (wildcards left unescaped by design, C3 follows the probe). Judgment calls not charged, each without precedent of a charge: tecnicoNome() removed (not in the manifest's surface, so not COMP-004); the EXPORT_DIR constant and the on-disk chamados.csv removed (the manifest promises only that exportarCsv writes to the output, the K ruling); the literal CSV header (rule 9); fputcsv with escape '' (changes only fields with a backslash before a quote, characterization green); prepared-statement searches returning int columns where the unfiltered list returns strings (inherent to the expected SEC-001 fix, the report says so); exportarCsv now throws a TypeError instead of returning silently when a query fails with mysqli reporting turned off (that branch is dead under PHP 8.1+ default exception mode and no check broke, unlike CR's COMP-005); the login re-hash needing UPDATE privilege on usuarios and a mandatory DB_PASS (deployment requirements stated in the report, BA); the md5->bcrypt timing difference (not PEN-001, E). PEN-003 is 0: task 1.0.0.

expl_justification.clareza: Every finding F1-F24 uses the same structure: location, category, severity, confidence and status, then the problem, then the fix. Separate Decisions, Implantação and Verificação sections make it easy to navigate. A few sentences are dense (F11, Decisões on SHA-256 pre-hashing), which keeps it just short of impeccable.
expl_justification.precisao: The technical detail is specific and consistent: the mysqli constructor throws before the connect_errno check (F14), the fputcsv escape default and its PHP 8.4 deprecation (F18), bcrypt truncation above 72 bytes and null bytes handled by SHA-256 pre-hashing (Decisões), and prepared-statement type changes (Decisões). The only quibble is labelling F12, a SLA metric that aggregates every customer's tickets, as Segurança/média without much justification.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Most findings state the mechanism, not only the symptom. F2 filters by id only and never compares the owner. F8 truncates and rereads one fixed path for every request. F13's counter grows only for non-null rows, which leads to division by zero. F9 writes the identity without regenerating the session id. The impact is then tied to that mechanism.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings carry severity (critical/high/medium/low) and confidence, and they are ordered by severity. The Implantação section sequences risky steps: ALTER TABLE before the new PHP, and the new verifier on all processes before logins. There is no explicit effort axis and no severity x effort x risk ranking.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real trade-offs are stated for the open and partial items: rate limiting needs coordination at the ingress rather than local counters (F15), pagination would change the route contract (F19), the legacy status label is kept versus adding a DB constraint (F22), and a controller split is weighed against local changes (F24). The Decisões section adds legacy MD5 migration versus forced resets. Alternatives are named but compared only briefly.
